episodes.synopsis: Join Akeno on her journey as she takes her first Maiden Voyage out to sea. She must graduate her high school so she can become part of the esteemed Blue Mermaids!
episodes.title: In a Pinch on Our Maiden Voyage!

episodes.synopsis: Akeno's ship, the Harekaze has mutinied?! Find out what happens as the group of girls enjoy their first meal together and welcome their first unexpected guest!
episodes.title: In a Pinch During Pursuit!

episodes.synopsis: Moka's ship is in trouble! Will Akeno be able to save her? What about this new beautiful blonde girl? Find out what happens as Akeno and her crew find a new friend in the most unlikely of places!
episodes.title: In a Pinch in Pajamas!

episodes.synopsis: With a new friend on board, what kind of cute adventures could they have all together? Watch as the girls' face one of their toughest problem yet!
episodes.title: Maidens in a Pinch!

episodes.synopsis: Finally, the Harekaze is free from the cloud of mutiny. We all know what that means, right? Time for some fun in the sun! Tune in as Akeno and the Harekaze watch a fantastic firework show!
episodes.title: Pinched by the Musashi!

episodes.synopsis: Will Akeno be able to save her beloved friend? Tune in this week as we go on a German Food Tour, and eat all the food! After all, what's mine is mine, right?
episodes.title: In a Mined Pinch!

episodes.synopsis: Akeno's family grows by the week! Who could they run in to this week? Tune in as we meet the new, cutest family member ever!
episodes.title: In a Stormy Pinch!

episodes.synopsis: It's time to find out about that big looming, scary ship! Who could that be? How should we welcome them this week? Find out as Akeno and her crew cook up some new ideas!
episodes.title: In a Pinch with the Hiei!

episodes.synopsis: Sisters at sea, Akeno's family grows by the episode! Tune in this week as we welcome even more family members in pink!
episodes.title: Mina in a Pinch!

episodes.synopsis: Don't worry Coco, it'll be okay! Tune in as we find out what the Harekaze crew members will do during two days of repair time!
episodes.title: Happy at the Equator Festival!

episodes.synopsis: Blue Mermaids to the rescue! Can the Harekaze keep up? Tune in this week as Operation: Perseus is a go!
episodes.title: In a Pinch with a Battleship's Big Cannon!

episodes.synopsis: Are you guys ready for the final fireworks show?! Grab your big shark plushie, and tune in as we join Akeno and her crew in this booming finale!
episodes.title: In a Pinch with the Last Battle!
